description: One stream of posts from the site's Bluesky, Mastodon and GitHub accounts in a scrolling region. Cook writes the first batch, a "More on" line and a state script inside it at build time; with JavaScript the element refreshes once per page view from the services' public APIs and loads more as the list scrolls. Without JavaScript the built entries are the whole feature.

attributes.name: accounts
attributes.description: Comma-separated account keys (service:handle, for example bluesky:example.bsky.social); default every visible Bluesky, Mastodon and GitHub account. A hidden account named here is included. Read by Cook at build time.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated hashtags without #, matched case-insensitively. Filters Bluesky and Mastodon; a block with tags shows no GitHub items. Read by Cook at build time.

attributes.name: items
attributes.description: First batch size, a whole number from 1 to 50; also the size of each batch loaded on scroll

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Height of the scrolling list: a rem, em, px or vh length. Cook writes it as --social-feed-height.

attributes.name: hide-counts
attributes.description: Leave out reply, repost and like counts

properties.name: refreshed
properties.description: Settles when this page view's refresh from the services has finished

childAttributes.name: data-id
childAttributes.description: The item id (service:native id) used to dedupe entries and update counts

childAttributes.name: data-service
childAttributes.description: The entry's service: bluesky, mastodon or github

a11y.pattern: A labelled, focusable scrolling region holding a WAI-ARIA feed (activity-feed) of articles
a11y.announces: Nothing; counts carry visually hidden labels

keyboard.action: Focus the scrolling list, then scroll it with the arrow keys
keyboard.when: The activity-feed is in the tab order
